summary: Large park car park; west edge backs onto bush and lawn, homes 40 m+.
reasons: West edge borders park lawn and trees
Nearest dwelling about 40 m, across road

drivers.seclusion: West side backs onto a grass strip and dense bush. Nearest dwellings (34 to 40 m) are south across Meiers Road; the pool and cafe buildings are non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed multi-row car park entering from the road on the south side. Spaces along the west edge.
drivers.traffic: Busy road along the south edge; the west side is set back from it.
drivers.convention: Public car park for Yeronga Park and the pool; hundreds of cars park there.

flags: Heavy daytime use by park and pool visitors
Locked gates mapped 5 m and 60 m away have a way round
Mapped waterway 2 m from outline, though ground is about 22 m
sun_shade: Bush shades the west edge in the afternoon; open to the morning sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the lot is locked after pool hours

best_section.where: West edge of the car park, beside the grass strip and bush
